body:
Five Nights at Freddy’s Inspired Minecraft Mod

This mod adds FNAF-inspired content to Minecraft, focused on atmosphere and visuals. It introduces a new dark-themed armor set inspired by Bonnie, designed to fit a creepy and mysterious style.

The mod also includes new decorative blocks, allowing you to create FNAF-like interiors such as checkered floors and enclosed rooms. These elements are ideal for horror maps, roleplay, or themed builds inspired by the Five Nights at Freddy’s universe.

This mod is mainly intended to enhance visual ambiance and immersion rather than gameplay complexity.
